Green Square Capital Has Raised Stake in Coca Cola Co Com (KO) by $589,455 as Valuation Declined; As Apple (AAPL) Stock Value Declined, Jackson Wealth Management Has Lifted Position by $369,054 
April 23, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers 
Green Square Capital Llc increased its stake in Coca Cola Co Com (KO) by 6.95% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Green Square Capital Llc bought 13,099 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.92% with the market. The hedge fund held 201,631 shares of the beverages (production and distribution) company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.25 million, up from 188,532 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Green Square Capital Llc who had been investing in Coca Cola Co Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $186.85 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.17% or $0.075 during the last trading session, reaching $43.815. About 7.69 million shares traded. The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO) has risen 1.35% since April 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.20% the S&P500. 
Jackson Wealth Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 4.02% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jackson Wealth Management Llc bought 2,121 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 54,931 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.58 million, up from 52,810 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jackson Wealth Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $834.73B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.73% or $1.21 during the last trading session, reaching $164.51. About 27.17 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
